articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: IBM opens beta Swift ledger link for 24/7 tokenized deposits
articles.description: IBM’s beta link lets banks instruct tokenized deposit transfers on Swift’s ledger using existing payment messages and compliance processes.

articles.title: Solana Foundation hires ex-Binance CMO and payments exec as new partnerships expand
articles.description: Rachel Conlan will oversee institutional partnerships and ecosystem growth, while Jamal Raees will focus on stablecoins and tokenized deposits, following a wave of new partnerships.

articles.title: HIFI raises $37M to expand stablecoin payments, tokenized markets
articles.description: HIFI CEO Zach Walsh told Cointelegraph the $37 million Series A is the company’s first priced funding round, though HIFI did not disclose its valuation.

articles.title: Era of pure crypto exchanges is ending, Bybit CEO says
articles.description: Bybit’s global campaign positions it as a broader financial platform, though its stock, gold and forex derivatives were already available.

articles.title: EU banking watchdog calls for crypto lending rules under MiCA
articles.description: The EBA outlined potential rules for crypto lending and firms providing access to DeFi protocols as part of the European Commission’s MiCA review.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $84K as 10-year Treasury yield hits 19-year high
articles.description: Bitcoin traded near $83,200 as Fed hike odds reached about 75% and Treasury prepared a $6 billion buyback of long-dated bonds.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $347M as BTC falls below $84K after topping $87K
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed to $347 million on Wednesday as Bitcoin fell below $84,000, while five-day inflows reached $2.65 billion.

articles.title: Institutions held crypto through 50% drawdown, Bitwise finds
articles.description: Every institution interviewed that owned crypto held Bitcoin, usually as its largest asset; some set exit conditions for Ether and Solana.

articles.title: Australia says OpenAI agent hacked government site before Altman warning
articles.description: OpenAI notified Australia nearly three months after its agent breached a government portal while gathering public medicine-spending data.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s ‘last resort’ quantum-safe solution just got 79% cheaper: StarkWare
articles.description: A weeklong optimization challenge cut the estimated GPU cost of preparing an experimental quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction to under $67, potentially making the “last-resort measure” a little easier on the wallet.

articles.title: US weighs overseas push for dollar-backed stablecoins: Bloomberg
articles.description: The reported initiative could involve private-sector companies and several US agencies as Washington looks to expand the international use of dollar-backed stablecoins.

articles.title: Kalshi says CFTC hasn’t contacted it over ‘unusual’ $5B trading activity
articles.description: Kalshi said nearly $5 billion in similarly sized Ether perpetual trades reflected its liquidity incentive programs and rejected allegations that the activity was wash trading.

articles.title: Ex-SEC acting chair: Agency dropped crypto cases to avoid issues with credibility
articles.description: SEC Commissioner Mark Uyeda said that the agency dropped many cases against crypto companies in early 2025 to avoid potential credibility problems in court.

articles.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang found dead at 37
articles.description: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.

articles.title: US lawmakers from gaming states urge SCOTUS to take up Kalshi case
articles.description: The case between New Jersey authorities and a prediction market company, if accepted by the Supreme Court, could result in clarity for state and federal officials over sports bets.

articles.title: Trump reveals up to $100K Strategy stock purchase in ethics filing
articles.description: President Donald Trump disclosed a July purchase of Strategy shares as his administration continues to advance crypto policy through federal regulators and Congress.

articles.title: US stablecoin adoption could surge with bank-like protections: Visa survey
articles.description: The survey released by Visa posited that bank-like protections for stablecoins could increase adoption in the US as companies are preparing for the enactment of the GENIUS Act.

articles.title: Bitwise launches first Lighter ETP amid Hyperliquid rivalry
articles.description: The product gives European investors brokerage access to the LIT token as Bitwise expands its lineup of products tied to decentralized derivatives platforms.

articles.title: NYSE, Blockchain.com in tie-up to bring tokenized US stocks to crypto users
articles.description: Blockchain.com users could gain access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs through NYSE’s planned digital trading platform under a new partnership, as bourses rush to deliver new trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin long liquidations hit $280M as BTC price dips under $84K
articles.description: Bitcoin long liquidations mounted as BTC/USD briefly traded below $84,000, while analysis flagged key support to hold.

articles.title: Raiffeisen to offer crypto trading across 11 European markets via Bitpanda
articles.description: Bitpanda will provide crypto infrastructure to Raiffeisen network banks, potentially extending digital asset access to about 18 million customers.

articles.title: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027
articles.description: National regulators will map client-facing uses of the technologies, check a subset of firms and develop common approaches to oversight.

articles.title: Winners and losers of the SEC’s new tokenized stocks rules
articles.description: The SEC has opened a five-year path for tokenized stocks, but only some products and venues fit the model. Will Uniswap, Robinhood, Coinbase or Kraken come out on top?

articles.title: MoonPay to buy North Capital in all-stock deal worth over $60M
articles.description: MoonPay’s North Capital acquisition adds US broker-dealer, trading and investment infrastructure as it expands into tokenized securities.

articles.title: Stablecoin cross-border flows surge 78%, defying crypto bear market
articles.description: Cross-border stablecoin transfers surged as the wider crypto market shrank 37%, with Chainalysis pointing to growing use for trade, remittances and savings.

articles.title: EU watchdogs warn quantum computers could pick crypto’s locks
articles.description: EU supervisors warn quantum computing could weaken blockchain security as Bitcoin developers weigh a draft migration plan and Ethereum targets 2029.

articles.title: CFTC chair pushes tokenization as SEC opens door to onchain stocks
articles.description: Michael Selig said tokenization could reshape financial markets as the CFTC and SEC continue advancing onchain initiatives despite the CLARITY Act setback.

articles.title: Bitcoin bull market ‘confirmed’ but $90K presents profit-taking risk: Analysis
articles.description: BTC price analysis concluded that onchain signals had “confirmed” the new Bitcoin bull market.

articles.title: BitMEX ends crypto trading, keeps withdrawals open after closure
articles.description: BitMEX officially ended exchange operations after more than 11 years, while withdrawals remain open as the crypto derivatives platform urges users to remove their funds.
